程序包 org.bukkit.event.block

类 BlockPlaceEvent

java.lang.Object
org.bukkit.event.Event
org.bukkit.event.block.BlockEvent
org.bukkit.event.block.BlockPlaceEvent
所有已实现的接口:
Cancellable
直接已知子类:
BlockMultiPlaceEvent
public class BlockPlaceEvent extends BlockEvent implements Cancellable
Called when a block is placed by a player. 当方块被玩家放置时调用。

If a Block Place event is cancelled, the block will not be placed. 如果方块放置事件被取消，方块将不会被放置。

      public boolean isCancelled()
      从接口复制的说明: Cancellable
      Gets the cancellation state of this event. A cancelled event will not be executed in the server, but will still pass to other plugins 获取此事件的取消状态。已取消的事件不会在服务器中执行，但仍会传递给其他插件
      指定者:
      isCancelled 在接口中 Cancellable
      返回:
      true if this event is cancelled 此事件已取消则为 true

    • canBuild

      public boolean canBuild()
      Gets the value whether the player would be allowed to build here. Defaults to spawn if the server was going to stop them (such as, the player is in Spawn). Note that this is an entirely different check than BLOCK_CANBUILD, as this refers to a player, not universe-physics rule like cactus on dirt. 获取是否允许玩家在此处建造。如果服务器原本要阻止他们（例如玩家位于出生点保护区内），则默认为与出生点相关的值。注意，这与 BLOCK_CANBUILD 是完全不同的检查，因为它针对的是玩家，而非诸如“仙人掌不能种在泥土上”这类世界物理规则。
      返回:
      boolean whether the server would allow a player to build here 服务器是否允许玩家在此处建造

      参数:
